title: Concrete condensed compact-support projection constructions
statement: Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings, with scalar extension preserving finite limits on each small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ be a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the archived internal-module ordinary derived categories put $P_\Lambda^c=Rg_{*,\Lambda}j_{!,\Lambda}$ and $T_a^W=\Lambda'_W\otimes^L_{\Lambda_W}-$, with the canonical scalar/restriction adjunction [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-comparisons]. The open operation is the actual exact sheafified extension by zero [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Define $T_a^Y P_\Lambda^c\to P_{\Lambda'}^c T_a^X$ by pasting the original proper coefficient counit mate $T_a^Y Rg_{*,\Lambda}\to Rg_{*,\Lambda'}T_a^Z$ with the original open scalar comparison $T_a^Z j_{!,\Lambda}\to j_{!,\Lambda'}T_a^X$. Use the tensor associator and unit induced by the actual restriction-of-scalars composition and identity. For a compactification refinement $r:c\to d$ and bounded constructible $K$ on $X$, define $P_\Lambda^dK\to P_\Lambda^cK$ by applying $Rg_{d,*}$ to the unique arrow $j_{d,!}K\to Rr_*j_{c,!}K$ whose open-adjunction transpose, followed by inverse-image composition and the proper counit of $r$, equals the original open unit for $j_c$; then apply the proper-image compositor. Retain this normalization before asserting invertibility. The coefficient projections commute with canonical shifts, tensor units and successive coefficient maps. The normalized proper/open lifts are natural on bounded constructible inputs, and refinement at the identity is the identity transformation. These definitions apply also to a finite-extension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient ring; no invertibility of the coefficient projection is built into its definition.

source.place: Original compact-support projection construction and its already proved coherence laws; blueprint proof Steps 6--15. Extracted unchanged to compile separately from the new composition proof.

proof.text: For identityScalar_flat, identify coefficientMap of the identity with the identity ring map. Compose Mod.extendScalarsIsoOfEq with Mod.extendScalarsId and transport finite-limit preservation from the identity functor with preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso. No coefficient-flatness hypothesis is used. The existing coefficientMap_id and tensor-unit isomorphism identify this functor with the identity; finite-limit preservation is invariant under natural isomorphism.

For condensedProjection_commShift, use the canonical right-derived unit shift calculation from lem-sp-canonical-right-derived-adjunction-shift. The factorization equation for each right-derived comparison is a shift-compatible composite. On K-injective representatives the source derived unit is invertible, so NatTrans.CommShift.of_comp_whiskerLeft_Qh gives shift compatibility of right-derived natural isomorphisms, exact-functor identifications, and composition identifications. Apply these to derivedComapLowerStarIso. The levelwise derived pullback comparison commutes with shifts as well. Equip scalar adjunctions with the shifts already specified by condensedScalarShift; their units and counits commute with shifts by commShift_of_rightAdjoint. The exact open adjunctions commute with the levelwise shifts. Expand the proper scalar mate and the open conjugate: every unit, counit, comparison, associator and whiskering commutes with shifts. Their paste is condensedProjection, so it commutes with shifts. The remaining coherence and refinement declarations keep their original statements; their proofs are recorded separately below. Name the existing scalar/restriction adjunction as condensedScalarAdjunction with the actual condensedScalar functors in its type. The scalar shift, scalar compositor and scalar identity use this same named construction; unfolding the name recovers the original source adjunction verbatim. The proper and open normalization equalities and the open conjugation equation are proved once, avoiding repeated reconstruction of the scalar functor types. Name its proper mate condensedPushScalar and its open mate condensedOpenScalar with the same canonical scalar functors. Use those two original mates in condensedProjection; unfolding the names restores its archived proper/open composite exactly.

For fieldRefinement_id, take the right-adjoint conjugate of the existing leftDerivedUpperStarId as the proper pushforward identity isomorphism. The proved right unit law for leftDerivedUpperStarComp identifies the identity refinement restriction with the pullback of this isomorphism. Under the open adjunction, the inverse proper identity satisfies the original normalization; fieldProperOpen_existsUnique therefore identifies it with fieldProperOpen. The proved left unit law for leftDerivedUpperStarComp, transported through conjugateEquiv, identifies fieldPushComp at the identity with the proper identity. Their two components cancel after the proper direct image, proving the identity natural transformation. The existing normalized_identity_lift argument is now the proved CategoryTheory.normalizedIdentityLift in CompactSupportIdentityCalculus; the other generic identity and shift helper proofs move to that private proof import unchanged. Uses the already proved source-library pullback unit laws in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.Derived.UpperStarCoherence, Mathlib adjunction mate identities, and the original fieldProperOpen_existsUnique declaration in this node; no new assumption.

For fieldRefinementApp_naturality, first prove that bounded constructible complexes are closed under binary biproducts: bound cohomology by the union of the two finite intervals, and use closure of constructible module objects under extensions on the split exact biproduct sequence. Use the generic counitRestrictionNat construction to compose the existing inverse-image compositor and proper counit naturally. Define fieldProperOpenRestrictionNat by that construction and the original restriction component by evaluation. The resulting component is exactly the original compositor followed by the image of the proper counit. Proved local tensor-colimit instance witnesses avoid repeatedly expanding the K-flat derivation data; they supply no additional assumptions. Uniqueness of the normalized lift on M = K biproduct L implies that postcomposition with the restriction at L is injective on Hom(K, U_d R_r J_c L): if two maps agree after restriction, insert their difference into the off-diagonal block of an endomorphism at M and add it to the unique normalized lift. Uniqueness forces this difference to vanish. Transpose the two proposed naturality composites under J_d adjoint U_d, then apply this injectivity. The normalization equation for fieldProperOpen and naturality of the open unit identify their restrictions. Finally apply the proper direct image and the natural proper compositor to obtain fieldRefinementApp_naturality. Assemble the normalized lift as fieldProperOpenNat and apply assembleLiftNat with the original proper compositor to obtain fieldRefinementNat. Define fieldRefinementApp by evaluation of this transformation; its naturality is then the proved naturality field. Named presentations fieldDerivedUpperStar, fieldDerivedLowerStar, fieldDerivedOpenShriek, fieldDerivedAdjunction and fieldDerivedPullComp retain the original derived data while preventing repeated expansion of their instance arguments. The retained identity proof uses generic adjunction unit and conjugate-composition calculations before specializing to the same source pullback unit laws. Keep the derived preadditive structure locally irreducible while specializing the generic uniqueness argument, so elaboration does not expand addition in the chosen localization. Proved public witnesses cache the fixed sheaf colimits, tensor additivity and base/module flat-resolution properties. The new witnesses are used locally while checking the constructions, then registered as instances at the end of the module; they infer the existing properties, with no additional assumption or new selected object. The original tensor-colimit witnesses retain their local registrations. Cache the fixed sheaf and module Grothendieck properties and K-injective-resolution property in the same way. Module colimits are cached as well. The ordinary coefficient restriction identity has an explicit functor type, fixing its original module categories once. In particular cache countable module coproducts, integer colimits and their exactness, and the existing K-flat quasi-isomorphism preservation of scalar extension. The three named derived functors, the refinement restriction transformation and component, and the assembled refinement transformation have their original functor types written explicitly; their constructor bodies are unchanged. The generic coefficient-composition and normalized-lift naturality helper proofs are now in the same CompactSupportIdentityCalculus private proof import; their statements and proofs are unchanged.

For condensedProjection_id, first normalize the ordinary restriction-of-scalars identity: its underlying module hom is the identity. The lower-star coefficient square therefore commutes with this normalization. For the open pullback square, cancel the canonical open coefficient collapse and use the action-component identification to obtain the same equation. Descend the exact pullback equation with mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_id. Descend the direct-image equation by the universal right-derived unit: on K-injective representatives its unit is invertible, and the derived square factorization reduces the equation to the ordinary square. Reuse the proved generic derived_square and square_fac calculations from ProperIntegralRationalScalarComparison. Transpose the proper mate under the scalar adjunctions and use the normalized scalar identity unit to show its composite with the scalar unit equals that unit on direct image. For the open comparison, apply the composite adjunction hom equivalence, the conjugate-unit equation and the same two scalar unit normalizations. Finally expand pasteScalar: naturality of the proper mate and the two component unit equations give precisely the displayed tensor-unit identity. All helpers are proved. The coefficient/refinement square retains its original statement and hole in the importing item module.

For condensedProjection_comp, identify the leftAdjointUniq scalar compositor with the conjugate of the inverse restriction compositor by its adjunction unit equation. Apply the existing ordinary direct-image restriction composition law and derived horizontal square composition. Pasting mates then gives composition of derivedPushHom with exactly the specified scalar compositor. For the open comparison, its underlying module hom followed by the open coefficient collapse is the collapse for the larger coefficient ring; this follows from the existing action-component identification. Cancel the collapse and use its naturality to prove composition of the ordinary restriction/pullback squares. Apply exact derived-square composition and invert the resulting equation. Conjugate pasting along the open and scalar adjunctions gives composition of derivedOpenImmersionShriekIso. Finally expand pasteScalar, use naturality of the second proper mate, apply the open equation inside direct image, and apply the proper equation. All helpers are proved. The coefficient/refinement square retains its original statement and hole in the importing item module.

For fieldProperOpen_existsUnique, apply condensedOpen_restrictedCounit_isIso to the underlying bounded constructible input. Unfold the original restriction normalization: its first factor is the inverse-image compositor, an isomorphism; its second is the open restriction of the proper counit, now an isomorphism. The normalization is therefore invertible. The proved generic private helper unique_normalized_lift constructs the transpose as the original open unit followed by the inverse normalization and applies the inverse open adjunction Hom equivalence. Its normalization follows by inverse cancellation; postcomposition with the normalization is injective, so the Hom equivalence also gives uniqueness. The original fieldProperOpen choice, all canonical maps and their signatures are unchanged. The coefficient/refinement square remains the original named hole. Refinement composition is proved separately in the importing item module. This is a decomposition: one original hole is replaced by the separate geometric counit lemma, with the entire adjunction assembly proved.

proof_origin.place: The original complete Lean construction and all its existing proved scalar and refinement-identity laws are relocated verbatim from the assigned module. The new composition proof and the sole unchanged coefficient/refinement hole stay in the assigned module. Generic proof helpers remain in their extracted private proof module.
